category_title: Low-attaining students lacking knowledge of mathematical representations like arrays
scenario_title: Calculating products in a playing card multiplication game
minimal_context: Riley is playing a multiplication game using playing cards to generate random numbers and needs to calculate nine multiplied by eight.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You drew a nine and an eight from the playing cards. Please calculate nine multiplied by eight.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is good because it was something different and we get to use playing cards and do the maths questions. Let me try to figure out nine times eight...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you use an array to help you calculate it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know what an array is.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I will show you what it looks like. Now you try drawing an array of nine by eight to find the answer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Spends most of the time for the game drawing the array) Okay, I drew an array of nine by eight. The answer is 70.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: You drew a nine and an eight from the playing cards. Please calculate nine multiplied by eight.

STUDENT: This is good because it was something different and we get to use playing cards and do the maths questions. Let me try to figure out nine times eight...

TUTOR: Why don't you use an array to help you calculate it?

STUDENT: I don't know what an array is.

TUTOR: I will show you what it looks like. Now you try drawing an array of nine by eight to find the answer.

STUDENT: (Spends most of the time for the game drawing the array) Okay, I drew an array of nine by eight. The answer is 70.

task.content: Calculate nine multiplied by eight during a multiplication game using playing cards to generate random numbers for equations.

context.environment: Classroom with MAB [Multi-based Arithmetic Blocks] at the back
context.time_context: Most of the time for this game

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Trying to calculate nine multiplied by eight
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Spent most of the time for this game trying to calculate nine multiplied by eight.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Seemed to enjoy the use of the cards in this lesson, although his understanding of products and factors did not seem supported by their use.
related_quotes: [The lesson was] good because it was something different and we get to use playing cards and do the maths questions.

behavior_patterns.condition: When suggested he use an array
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Riley didn’t know what an array was.

behavior_patterns.condition: After being shown how to draw an array of nine by eight
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: He drew an array of nine by eight although his final answer was incorrect.
